fact: On 18 June 2025 the ministry officially launched the Registre Social Unique, made available to all social-action actors for identifying and qualifying poor and vulnerable households.
title: CEREMONIE DE LANCEMENT DU REGISTRE SOCIAL UNIQUE, DU PAIEMENT DE TRANSFERTS MONETAIRES A 70 000 NOUVEAUX MENAGES BENEFICIAIRES DES FILETS SOCIAUX ET DU PROJET « POPOTE FAMILIALE »
